head: Nāda Brahma: sound meditation with real gongs, bowls and chimes
dek: Nāda Brahma is a sound-meditation app built on recordings of real instruments, like gongs, singing bowls, crystal, chimes and handpan, with moving visuals. It was #40 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 6 November and costs $6.99 with in-app purchases, by Philip Franklin Marks.
means: If you relax with sound baths, you can have one on your phone.
todo: Find Nāda Brahma in the App Store.
thumb_words: A SOUND BATH ON YOUR PHONE
